sections.content: Add -n to a day name to say 'on' that day. A linking vowel appears where needed, and it follows vowel harmony: kedden (front e), szerdán (back á), csütörtökön (front rounded ö), pénteken (front e), szombaton (back o).
vasárnap is the exception that proves the rule: it already IS the 'on Sunday' form, so nothing gets added — 'vasárnapon' would be wrong. Just say vasárnap.
